releases.body:
Initial release of oc-mcp-plugin-manager for OpenCode 2.0.16 and later. OpenCode 1 is not supported.

- Project-specific MCP enable/disable overrides and immediate configuration refresh.
- MCP tool indexing, terminal reconnect, and sidebar filtering.
- Project/global installer that preserves existing JSONC settings.

Install from npm:

```sh
npx oc-mcp-plugin-manager@0.1.0 init --full
```

Validation: 80 tests passed, type checks and builds passed, clean npm archive installation passed; integration verified with OpenCode 2.0.22.

Published on npm as [oc-mcp-plugin-manager@0.1.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/oc-mcp-plugin-manager/v/0.1.0).
